'''Clubs''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Byrne City]] on the planet [[Demophon]]. It was owned by [[Lorle|"Ace" Lorle]]. Lorle used his establishment to gather information on local workers, selling word of any suspicious activities to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] or to corporate interests. Clubs was destroyed during the [[Demophon supernova]].<ref name="BE" />
